_meta.description: Universal schema template for all external data ingested into the Autumn NLP reference database. Every document type — article, journal, book, blog, technical doc — conforms to this schema after normalization by the scrape scripts.

id_scheme.description: Document ID prefix by type. Format: PREFIX-YYYYMMDD-NNNN

id.description: Unique document ID per id_scheme above

doc_type.description: One of: article, journal, book, blog, technical, educational, script, podcast, survey, interview, user_upload

genre.description: Subject/genre tag: aerospace, science, philosophy, finance, health, social, political, technical, spiritual, creative, etc.

subgenre.description: More specific topic within genre, e.g. 'quantum computing' under 'science'

source.description: Publication, author, URL, or origin identifier

date_added.description: Date document was ingested into the database

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code: en, es, fr, de, pt, ja, zh, ar

word_count.description: Approximate word count of original document

vowel_frequency.description: Normalized frequency per vowel: {a:0.08, e:0.12, i:0.07, o:0.09, u:0.05}

consonant_class_freq.description: Normalized frequency per consonant class: {stops:0.18, fricatives:0.14, ...}

punctuation_map.description: Count of each punctuation type used: {P_PERIOD:42, P_QUESTION:8, ...}

tense_distribution.description: Proportion of each tense identified: {present_simple:0.4, past_simple:0.3, ...}

dominant_sequence.description: Most frequent sequence pattern detected (SEQ_A through SEQ_J)

brpn_profile.description: BRPN shell and tool analysis for this document

dominant_tool.description: Primary natural tool detected across document

tool_distribution.description: Proportion of each tool triggered: {MAZE:0.2, PUZZLE:0.15, ...}

emotion_profile.description: Emotion classification from routing table analysis

primary_emotion.description: Top emotion identified from EMO vocabulary

emotion_distribution.description: Weighted presence of each emotion across document

content_summary.description: Compact content representation for NLP reference

summary.description: 3-5 sentence plain-language summary of document content

key_concepts.description: Top 10 concept nouns or named entities extracted from document

key_verbs.description: Top 10 action verbs — defines the motion/intent signature

key_sequences.description: Notable grammatical sequences extracted as labeled patterns

nlp_tags.description: Flat tag array for fast lookup and cross-referencing

emotions.description: All detected emotion IDs from EMO vocabulary

sequences.description: All matched sequence pattern IDs (SEQ_A through SEQ_J)

sigs.description: All sigma signatures detected in document

raw_chunks.description: Optional: tokenized content chunks for direct NLP reference use. Only include when document is short enough to store inline.

chunk_schema.text: string — raw text of this chunk (max 500 chars)
chunk_schema.sig: string — sigma signature of this chunk
chunk_schema.tool: string — dominant tool for this chunk
chunk_schema.emotion: string — primary emotion detected in this chunk

example_record.title: Hypersonic Aerospike Nozzle Thermal Management Survey

content_summary.summary: A survey of thermal management strategies for hypersonic aerospike nozzle configurations, analyzing material properties, cooling channel geometries, and heat flux mitigation under Mach 6-12 flight conditions.
